title: Successor comparison of even generalized binomial coefficients
statement: Let $p,q,\rho\in\mathbb R$ satisfy $0<q<p<1$, $\rho\ge0$, and $\rho^2=(1-p)/(1-q)$, and let $K\ge1$ be an integer. If $\binom{p}{2K}\le (p/q)\binom{q}{2K}\rho^{2K}$ for the generalized binomial coefficients, then $\binom{p}{2(K+1)}\le (p/q)\binom{q}{2(K+1)}\rho^{2(K+1)}$.
replaced: Let $0<q<p<1$, $\rho\ge0$, $\rho^2=(1-p)/(1-q)$, and integer $K\ge1$. If $\binom p{2K}\le(p/q)\binom q{2K}\rho^{2K}$, then $\binom p{2K+2}\le(p/q)\binom q{2K+2}\rho^{2K+2}$, with generalized binomial coefficients.
